_: Every spelling of the reserved `## For humans` heading, and the near misses, in one
list — because the bug this file exists to prevent is three parsers disagreeing about
The parsers: crates/agentmon-core/src/body.rs (the guard and both record readers),
scripts/project-fs.mjs (the browser transport) and src/lib/markdown-parse.ts (what the
app actually draws). Round 3 shipped with the guard narrower than the renderer, so
`##<TAB>For humans` in a --body was written without complaint and the Agent view then
drew a level-2 heading reading 'For humans' over prose saying it was not one.
`reserved` means: this line, standing in a record body outside a code fence, IS the
record's human-area heading — refused in agent-supplied prose (exit 2), and read as
the start of the human area on disk. Read by crates/agentmon-core/tests/human_area.rs
and by scripts/markdown-smoke.mjs, which additionally proves the app never draws a
heading reading 'For humans' inside an agent-area payload.
Every line is written with \u escapes on purpose. Half of these shapes are invisible
and the other half are letters drawn exactly like other letters, so a fixture spelled
with the characters themselves is a fixture no reviewer can check — which is the
